decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion authority contrary to the administrator-or-owner rule; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold matches required lowercase behavior after trimming; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior and tests pass, but empty-sequence behavior changed from None to ValueError and the specification leaves it unspecified.
Malformed and out-of-range inputs now return 0 instead of raising ConfigError; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the total test fails.

strategy_update: Used specification semantics, exact scoped diffs, and committed tests; abstained only where the claim depended on explicitly unspecified behavior.
